name: Dialpad AI Agents
positioning: AI voice and digital agents sold as part of Dialpad's unified communications and contact-centre platform, priced in conversation credits.

pricing.model: Conversation-based credits; pool of AI Agent Credits, price not published
pricing.headline: Customers buy a pool of AI Agent Credits; a conversation is billable when the AI retrieves information or performs an action. No public rate.
planNotes: Pricing page: 'You purchase a pool of AI Agent Credits'; 'Credits are used when AI delivers value'.
A conversation is billable when the AI retrieves information or executes an action such as scheduling, routing or order lookup.
The AI Agent product sits beside Support, Sell and Connect plans; contact sales for AI Agent pricing.

strengths.claim: Vendor states SOC 2 Type II, HIPAA readiness with one-click BAA signing, and GDPR support.
Part of a full telephony and contact-centre platform, so voice, humans and AI agents share one system.
Describes zero-code agent building and a hand-off to human agents with full transcript and context.
Billing is per billable conversation rather than per minute, with no charge when no work is done.
Offers out-of-the-box skills such as order status, appointment scheduling and password resets.

limitations.claim: The AI Agent price is not published; the pricing page points to sales and an ROI estimate.

integrations: CRM systems (agent actions are logged to CRM)

compliance.note: Stated by vendor, self-attested on the Trust page: 'SOC2 Type II compliant', 'HIPAA-ready' with BAA, and GDPR support. Applies to Dialpad products generally; AI Agent-specific scope not separately confirmed.

telephony.providedNumbers: Dialpad is itself a cloud telephony provider; number options for AI Agent were not described on the pages read.

bestFor: Organisations already on, or willing to adopt, Dialpad for telephony and contact-centre who want AI agents in the same platform.
